retrieval.note: v3: re-verified H-Net/dnaHNet venue (H-Net arXiv 2507.07955; genomic variant dnaHNet = ICML 2026 Spotlight, OpenReview 6pN2KNCspk), PatchDNA ICLR 2026 (OpenReview AFZeojzjoG) in addition to bioRxiv v1, MergeDNA arXiv 2511.14806, DNAChunker arXiv 2601.03019. Added architecture_family / patching_mechanism / code_or_weights_available / identical_backbone_diff_rule fields and the dynamic-segmentation family overview. Unverified fields kept as UNKNOWN_VERIFY, never fabricated.

dynamic_segmentation_families.blt_like: entropy / conservation / merging guided patch rules over a latent Transformer system (BLT 3-stage: local encoder + latent global Transformer + local decoder). Members: our P1-P3/B1, PatchDNA, MergeDNA.
dynamic_segmentation_families.hnet_like: differentiable learned chunk-boundary prediction with U-Net-like hierarchy, tokenizer-free and end-to-end. Members: H-Net, dnaHNet.
dynamic_segmentation_families.flat_token: static tokenizers over an ordinary flat Transformer (NUC/BPE/Unigram/k-mer) - our F1-F7.

architecture_overview.verdict: No single widely-accepted dynamic-segmentation architecture exists; the family split means cross-family comparisons are complete-system comparisons only, never tokenizer-causal. Our design isolates rule effects within one BLT instance (identical_backbone_diff_rule for P1-P3).
